sources.title: Longmen, Zhejiang
sources.excerpt: Longmen is a town of 7000 in Fuyang District, Hangzhou, northwestern Zhejiang province, People's Republic of China, located 17 kilometres (11 mi) south of the center of Fuyang District. The town lies south of the Fuchun River, at the foothills of the Xianxia Range, and oversees 11 administrative villages. Over 90% of its people are surnamed Sun.
